body.why: A systemic heart circulates blood around the body, and two branchial, or gill, hearts pump it through the two gills. The systemic heart becomes inactive when the animal is swimming.

probes.question: True or false: octopuses have three hearts.
What do an octopus's two gill hearts do?
options: Pump ink out of the body
